demo_phrases.text: Imagine a monument that changes with the light.
Its white marble glows softly at sunrise
Look closer at the carved flowers,
the balanced gardens, and the reflections in the water.
Every detail invites you to slow down.
Some places are more than buildings.
They become stories that the world remembers.
